document.type: research prototype - NOT a certified battery passport
document.regulation_reference: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (Annex XIII fields, for orientation only)
document.disclaimer: RESEARCH PROTOTYPE - NOT A CERTIFIED BATTERY PASSPORT. This document is generated by a university research project (CellSense). It is not issued under, and makes no claim of compliance with, Regulation (EU) 2023/1542. The numbers are model estimates with the stated uncertainty and limits; they are not measurements and must not be used for safety-critical, commercial or legal decisions without an independent measured capacity test.

battery.data_provenance: ul_pur public dataset, processed by this project

state_of_health.interval_note: 90% conformal interval calibrated on known sources
state_of_health.definition: discharge capacity relative to the battery's first cycles, in percent
state_of_health.interval_method: split conformal, 90% target (alpha = 0.1): one fixed half-width calibrated on held-out batteries of the training pool and applied to every battery; it is an in-domain guarantee only and is not adaptive
state_of_health.measured_checkpoints_note: no measured capacity values are used for this battery; the estimate comes from the cycle curves only

expected_remaining_life.reason: its nearest known source is ul_pur, which the RUL model was never trained on (it only saw NASA+MIT)
expected_remaining_life.rule: RUL is shown only when the nearest known source is NASA or MIT and the battery is not flagged

trust_status.status: No distribution shift detected (this is not a guarantee)
trust_status.not_detected_note: About 1 in 5 unfamiliar batteries are not detected; check against a measured capacity when possible.

input_sanity_check.note: not run: built-in dataset (the one-class SVM check is applied to uploads)

model_provenance.routing_note: routing was selected on held-out data, so it is a deployment choice, not an unbiased test result
